pronunciation.approximation: Say "gula" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Gula".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "gula" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Gula" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Gula
domains.subtitle: Healing
domains.lead: Gula is healing, medicine. The name means "The great one" and belongs to the mesopotamian tradition.

cards.name: Living Tradition
cards.desc: Honored in mesopotamian myth, cult, and cultural memory.

mythology.lead: The stories of Gula place healing, medicine at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Gula appears in mesopotamian tradition as healing, medicine. The name's meaning, "The great one", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Gula in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Gula remains a touchstone for understanding mesopotamian religion, art, and identity.
